note: Rejudged after 438bb234e4 changed run and performAction. run's echo ticker arm now stops the ticker and returns when echoRequestRejected is set (the peer Code-Rejected an Echo-Request); performAction's ser action now sends no Echo-Reply when echoReplyRejected is set. Re-read Section 5.8: 'Echo-Request and Echo-Reply packets MUST only be sent in the LCP Opened state.' Both changes only suppress sends; neither adds an Echo emission or a path outside Opened. The ticker is still armed only at the Opened edge and stopped on leaving it, and ser is still produced only by RXR in Opened (LCPDoTransition unchanged). RXJ- is newly reachable from a received reject, but its Opened edge (irc,str to Stopping) and its other edges carry no ser and stop the keepalive with Opened. All five tagged units are unchanged and send no Code-Reject, so neither flag is set under them. TestRFC1661KeepaliveEchoOnlyInOpened still requires the configured request retransmission, never a stale Echo, after renegotiation. TestRFC1661NoEchoOutsideOpened still forbids both Echo Codes in ReqSent/AckSent/AckRcvd/Stopped with a valid peer Magic. TestRFC1661EchoReplyInOpened still requires the exact reply, a positive that the new suppression would break if it fired unconditionally. TestClientLCPEchoBeforeOpenDiscarded still keeps only the original Configure-Request. The verdict holds. This rests on reading the assertions and producers; no new runtime evidence is claimed.
